text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios tore through her first three years
in the Twinkle Series, partying hard and loud
just like the party girl she is.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Well, let's kick it into overdrive today too!
Ready to rock, Palmer-chin☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
OK Helios, my sun!
Let's hype it all the way up!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By her side was always her bestie, Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Whooooaaaa!!
Blow 'em away!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Beyond a runaway sprint!!
It's a godly escapeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!!
Those two are at it again!!
The pace is completely messed up!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she pushing the pace way too hard?!
...Haha, holy crap, that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Way to go~~!
Go all out, BFF duo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Those two seriously cause a ruckus
no matter where they go, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You say that,
but you seem to be having quite a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
When they put on a show that flashy...
all I can do is laugh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P!
What's the plan for the next race!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And Palmer's with us for life, toootally~☆
Also, you see—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, don't you wanna level up soon?
Like advancing to a whole new stage!”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right on~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P, countin' on ya!
Let's take it to the next level, rough and ready!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Train-pi,
you know how to party, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, how's it going?
Gotten any good ideas yet?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see the "PalmaHeli Channel"?
Apparently they have a huge announcement today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Don't tell me you're breaking up the duo...
or worse, a double retirement!?
We just hit 5 million subscribers, too!

text_block_list.name: Passersby A & B
text_block_list.text: You've definitely gotta watch it!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Aand, to everyone watching
the Pama-Heli Channel!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "I'm a Mejiro, but I'm Palmer☆ That's Mejiro Palmer to you!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Lately I'm more of a DM girl than a LANE girl!
Daitaku Helios here~☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Aight!
Shall we wrap this up quick?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Alright! And with that, we have a major announcement from the PalmaHeli Channel!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So, we have a very special...!!
A very, special, a-n-n-o-u-n-c-e-m-e-n-t~~~?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be an event race organizer!
*Clap clap clap*~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "The name is Twinkle Fest! Take it away, Palmer-chin☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! So, um,
the Twinkle Fes is a massive race event made possible through the cooperation of Tracen Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"As you all know, Helios's Trainey-pie,
or rather, our manager-poyo, really busted their chops for us!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "So, to explain in detail—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Basically, what I'm sayin' is
why don't we all just party like crazy!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"‘Anyone who wants to get hyped, c'mon over☆
Also recruiting folks who wanna run~!!
DM me!!’"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Also, slide into my DMs, Milady☆
I'll be waiting for that date invite forever~!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Did something exciting happen?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Apparently Helios and Palmer
are doing an exhibition race."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It looks like so much fun!
Oh, and they said they want a DM from Ruby too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I will take that matter into consideration.
By the way..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I heard that prospects look good for her running in next year's Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! The rehab specialists,
the doctors, the teachers at the academy...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So many people gave me their seal of approval,
saying, "It'll be ready in time for the big day!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's not set in stone yet.
But my legs are... already totally fine!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Ruby being there for me... so, so much through my rehab.
Thank you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for thanks.
I also owe you for accompanying me
during my training before.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If things keep progressing smoothly like this,
we might even make it in time for Helios-san's project that you mentioned earlier.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Right now, there's immense attention on them, and the participants should comprise an illustrious lineup.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A victory there—will surely be added
as another glorious achievement for our family.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Wouldn't that also lead to repaying Miss Miracle for her kindness?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yeah, that's true.
I was thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Ruby... I'm counting on you.
I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make
a new "miracle" happen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~☆
So hot~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is getting crazy hyped!!
My heart's pounding...!
choice_data_list: Lots of people are watching the live viewing too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fuuuuu!!
This is straight up a music festival!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, I am SO hyped!
What's gonna happen to me!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Awesome!
Let's hype it all the way up and blast off into outer space!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I know, right~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Heliooos! Palmer...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't it almost our turn?!
Alright, let's get our fest on!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy~â

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Get super hyped too, Trainy-P♪
I'm counting on you to hold down the floor☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's always noisy and lively around Daitaku Helios.
And moving forward, she will surely keep shining and laughing
brightly like the sun.
